Historical Ada tooling

Aflex and Ayacc 1.4a

This repository preserves the University of California, Irvine Aflex lexical-analyzer generator and Ayacc parser generator used by Abuild.

Documentation

Aflex manual Scanner generation, input format and runtime interface Ayacc manual Grammar format, parser generation and command-line options

Repository branches

master
The frozen original source import.
abuild
The compatibility patches used by the Abuild submodule.
abuild-gh
The Abuild patch set plus GitHub CI and this documentation site.

Maintenance status

This is a compatibility archive, not the current upstream. New projects should evaluate the maintained Ada-France Aflex and Ada-France Ayacc repositories. Their code is intentionally not synchronized into this historical branch family.

Source and licensing

See the repository overview for the maintained branch model, build instructions and CI coverage. The preserved historical notices are collected in COPYING.
